ARMS.notes: Guide order at 60: weapon damage > hit > expertise > crit > strength (> agility > stamina in the beta list). 1 STR = 2 AP; AGI gives 1% crit per 20 at 60 plus 2 armor. Priority list is guide importance; weights are per point / per 1%, so percent stats are numerically larger than DPS even though the weapon is the #1 upgrade (2H math alone gives ~7 STR per weapon DPS; bumped to 8 for Forever's weapon emphasis). Forever: hit and crit are unified across melee/ranged/spell, so SHIT/SCRIT mirror HIT/CRIT; weapon-skill items heavily nerfed and replaced by Expertise; white-hit rage is normalized (weapon damage does not raise rage per swing, crits double it). Weaponmaster pools weapon-type bonuses. HASTE is not ranked by any guide (scarce on gear; Skyborne racial); weight 10 per 1% is an estimate (more swings = more damage and rage).
